name: ThinkRank – AI SEO Assistant (LLMs, Schema, Metadata, Sitemaps, GA4)
author: WPDeveloper

sections.description:
ThinkRank is an AI-native SEO plugin designed for WordPress that helps you create better content and optimize your website for search engines. Unlike other SEO plugins, ThinkRank leverages artificial intelligence to provide intelligent content suggestions, comprehensive SEO analysis, and automated optimization recommendations.

Key Features (Always Free)

AI-Powered Content Tools

  • AI Content Brief Generator – Create comprehensive content outlines with competitor analysis and gap identification
  • AI Metadata Generation – Auto-generate SEO-optimized titles and meta descriptions with SERP preview
  • Real-time SEO Score Calculator – 13-factor algorithm with actionable improvement suggestions
  • Competitor Analysis – Analyze competitor content structure, keywords, and SEO strategies
  • SERP Preview – Live preview of how your content appears in search results

Essential SEO Management

  • Site Identity Management – Complete site-wide SEO configuration (Basic Info, Title Formats, Breadcrumbs, Hero & Branding, Business Info)
  • Schema Manager – Organization schema, website markup, and structured data management with deployment validation
  • Social Media Optimization – Open Graph, Twitter Cards, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Pinterest integration with real-time preview
  • Performance Monitoring – Core Web Vitals tracking, PageSpeed insights, and technical SEO diagnostics
  • Analytics Integration – Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and AI-powered insights with intelligent reporting

Crawling & AI Indexing

  • Robots.txt Management – AI-optimized robots.txt generation, validation, and automatic sitemap integration
  • XML Sitemap Generation – Multiple sitemap types (Basic, Complete, E-commerce, Segmented) with AI content optimization
  • LLMs.txt for AI – Specialized file for AI search engines and LLM indexing with automated generation
  • AI Search Optimization – Prepare your content for next-generation AI-powered search engines

Analytics & Intelligence

  • SEO Analytics Dashboard – Traffic analysis, organic search performance, and keyword opportunity identification
  • AI-Powered Insights – Natural language explanations and optimization recommendations
  • PageSpeed Insights Integration – Real-time Core Web Vitals, technical SEO diagnostics, and improvement opportunities
  • Intelligent Reporting – Automated alerts, trend analysis, and actionable recommendations

Technical Features

  • Post/Page Integration – Seamless metabox integration for all content types with real-time optimization
  • Multi-AI Provider Support – Works with OpenAI (GPT-4o), Claude (Claude 3.7 Sonnet), and Google Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Flash) with intelligent model selection
  • Local SEO – Business information, operating hours, location data, and local schema markup
  • Your API Key Control – Complete cost transparency and control with your own AI provider keys

Your API Key, Your Control

ThinkRank uses your own AI API keys, giving you:
– Complete cost transparency and control
– No monthly subscription fees for the core plugin
– Unlimited usage based on your AI provider plan
– Enhanced privacy – your data stays between you and your chosen AI provider

Perfect For

  • Content Creators & Bloggers – AI-powered content briefs and SEO optimization
  • E-commerce Store Owners – Product SEO optimization and performance monitoring
  • SEO Professionals & Agencies – Comprehensive SEO management with client reporting
  • WordPress Developers – Technical SEO tools and performance diagnostics
  • Local Businesses – Local SEO optimization with business information management
  • Enterprise Websites – Advanced analytics, schema management, and AI indexing
  • Anyone wanting to improve their content’s search visibility – User-friendly interface with AI guidance

Technical Excellence

Built with modern WordPress development standards:
– PHP 8.0+ with strict typing
– React 18+ admin interface
– WordPress 6.0+ compatibility
– Security-first approach with proper sanitization and nonce verification
– Performance optimized with intelligent caching

Privacy

This plugin does not send any data to third parties except to the AI provider you configure (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google AI) when you explicitly use AI features. API keys are stored in your database and are not transmitted to us. No telemetry is collected by ThinkRank.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements
* WordPress 6.0 or higher
* PHP 8.0 or higher
* OpenAI API key OR Claude API key (Anthropic)

Automatic Installation
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
2. Go to Plugins → Add New
3. Search for “ThinkRank”
4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
4. Activate the plugin

Setup
1. Go to ThinkRank → Settings in your WordPress admin
2. Choose your AI provider (OpenAI or Claude)
3. Enter your API key
4. Select your preferred AI model
5. Save settings and start optimizing!

Getting API Keys
* OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
* Claude (Anthropic): https://console.anthropic.com/
* Gemini (Google AI): https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-key
sections.faq:
Do I need an AI API key to use this plugin?

Yes, ThinkRank requires an OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini API key to function. This approach gives you complete control over costs and ensures your data privacy. The plugin itself is free — you only pay your AI provider directly for usage.

Which AI models are supported?

OpenAI (examples):
– GPT-5-nano (default), GPT-5-mini, GPT-5, GPT-4o

Claude (examples):
– Claude 4 Sonnet, Claude 4 Opus, Claude 3.7 Sonnet (default), Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku

Gemini (examples):
– Gemini 2.5 Flash (default), 2.5 Flash Lite, 2.5 Pro, 2.0 Flash, 1.5 Flash

Support for the latest stable models of each provider. Defaults can be changed in Settings.

How much does AI usage cost?

Costs depend on your chosen AI provider and usage:
– OpenAI GPT-4o: ~$0.01-0.03 per content brief
– Claude 3.7 Sonnet: ~$0.01-0.02 per content brief
– Actual costs vary based on content length and complexity

Is my data secure?

Yes. ThinkRank follows WordPress security best practices:
– API keys are encrypted in your database
– All data is sanitized and validated
– Nonce verification for all requests
– Your content is only sent to your chosen AI provider

Can I use this with WooCommerce?

Yes! ThinkRank includes WooCommerce integration for optimizing product pages, though advanced e-commerce features are available in our premium extensions.

Does this conflict with other SEO plugins?

ThinkRank is designed to work alongside other SEO plugins. However, for best results, we recommend using ThinkRank as your primary SEO solution to avoid conflicting meta tags.

Can I export my content briefs?

Yes, all generated content briefs can be exported in multiple formats for use in external tools or documentation.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

By default, ThinkRank preserves your API keys and generated content when uninstalled. You can change this behavior in Settings → Data Management if you prefer to delete everything.

Does ThinkRank work with Google Analytics and Search Console?

Yes! ThinkRank includes comprehensive analytics integration with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google PageSpeed Insights. You can connect your accounts in the Essential SEO → Analytics section for AI-powered insights and performance monitoring.

Is there rate limiting to prevent overuse?

Yes. You can enable rate limiting in Settings to cap AI requests per minute and prevent accidental overuse.

What is LLMs.txt and why do I need it?

LLMs.txt is a specialized file that helps AI search engines and language models better understand and index your website content. As AI-powered search becomes more prevalent, this file ensures your content is properly represented in AI search results and recommendations.

Can I generate multiple types of sitemaps?

Yes! ThinkRank offers multiple sitemap types including Basic, Complete, E-commerce, and Segmented sitemaps. You can customize which content types to include and generate AI-optimized sitemaps that improve your search engine visibility.

How does the competitor analysis work?

ThinkRank analyzes competitor URLs to provide insights on content structure, keyword usage, SEO strategies, and technical implementation. This helps you identify content gaps and optimization opportunities to outrank your competition.
